name: tournmate-server
description: Firebase Cloud Functions backend for TournMate sports tournament app

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test:emulator-cricket-live: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-tournmate "node lib/scripts/emulatorCricketLiveChecks.js"
scripts.test:draw-emulator: npm run build && cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project demo-tournmate "node functions/lib/scripts/emulatorDrawTest.js"
scripts.test:emulator-core: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,storage --project demo-tournmate "node lib/scripts/emulatorCoreChecks.js"
scripts.test:emulator-feedback-email: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-tournmate "node lib/scripts/emulatorFeedbackEmailChecks.js"
scripts.test:emulator-feedback: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-tournmate "node lib/scripts/emulatorFeedbackChecks.js"
scripts.test:emulator-broadcast: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-tournmate "node lib/scripts/emulatorBroadcastChecks.js"
scripts.test:emulator-photos: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage,auth --project demo-tournmate "node lib/scripts/emulatorPhotoChecks.js"
